Encounter Summary:
- Post-op day 7 follow-up after right middle finger ganglion cyst excision.
- Wound is healing well without documented complications.
- Finger exam is normal for range of motion and sensation.
- Pathology documents ganglion cyst.
- Assessment documents status post right middle finger ganglion cyst excision with primary healing.

Documentation Gaps:
- No clear CDI-significant documentation gap is supported by this excerpt alone.
  - Why it matters: A provider query should only be issued when clarification is necessary and supported by the record.
  - Evidence quote: "post-op day 7 follow-up after right middle finger ganglion cyst excision," "Wound healing well, no erythema or discharge," "Normal finger range of motion and sensation," "Pathology: ganglion cyst," and "Diagnosis: status post right middle finger ganglion cyst excision, primary healing."
  - Minimal clarification needed: None based on the excerpt provided.
- Possible minor specificity limitation, but not clearly query-worthy from this excerpt alone:
  - Gap: Exact anatomic origin/site of the ganglion cyst is not described beyond "right middle finger."
  - Why it matters: Some coding scenarios may require more precise anatomic site detail.
  - Evidence quote: "right middle finger ganglion cyst excision"
  - Minimal clarification needed: Specific anatomic origin/site of the cyst only if required by the intended code set or payer rule.

Proposed Provider Queries:
- None recommended based on the current excerpt.
- Optional only if code-set or payer-specific requirements demand finer site detail:
  - Topic: Anatomic origin/site of the ganglion cyst
  - Reason query is needed: The lesion is documented as involving the "right middle finger," but the exact origin/site is not further specified.
  - Evidence quote: "right middle finger ganglion cyst excision"
  - Non-leading query text: "If clinically known and documented, please clarify the specific anatomic origin/site of the excised ganglion cyst of the right middle finger."
  - Suggested response options: joint-related, tendon sheath-related, soft tissue/other structure, other, clinically undetermined.

Coding Specificity Checklist:
- Laterality: right
- Digit involved: middle finger
- Postoperative status/follow-up documented
- Healing status/complication status documented
- Final pathology documented as ganglion cyst
- If needed for coding specificity: exact anatomic origin/site of the cyst

Risk Flags:
- No contradictions identified in the excerpt.
- No unsupported diagnoses identified.
- No copied-forward risk indicators apparent from the excerpt.
- Uncertainty: whether more granular anatomic site detail is actually required cannot be determined from this excerpt alone.
